text:
Rohan Mehta: Heads up
ByteBridge Pvt Ltd sent invoice BB-2026-77 for platform integration (USD) but included 18% GST and no GSTIN or PAN on the PDF. They say payment will come from Redwood US. Can we process or should we ask for corrected invoice? :confused:

Claire Huang: For Indian suppliers, GSTIN must be on a tax invoice if GST is charged. Also exports of services can be zero-rated if conditions met (payment in convertible foreign exchange, LUT or bond, and proof of export). If they're billing from India and charging GST, they should provide GSTIN and tax breakup.

Isha Verma: Note on TDS: If ByteBridge is an Indian resident entity, Indian TDS rules may require withholding on certain payments. But since payment originates from Redwood US, withholding depends on place of supply and tax treaty; usually our AP doesn't gross-up. We need vendor PAN for TDS reporting if applicable.

Rohan Mehta: I replied asking for: (1) GSTIN on invoice, (2) PAN for any TDS purposes, (3) clarification whether supply is export of services and if they will issue invoice zero-rated under LUT. Told them payment may be held until we get docs.

tax-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Verify GSTIN via GST portal 2) If zero-rated under LUT, vendor should confirm receipt in convertible forex and provide LUT copy or export evidence 3) For TDS, require PAN.

Claire Huang: If they insist on charging GST despite export claim, we should get GSTIN and tax amount. If we pay and later it's incorrect, we'll need credit note. Don't agree to gross-up; finance policy: no gross-ups for vendor tax documentation gaps without manager approval.

Isha Verma: Also ask procurement to confirm which legal entity is being billed (Redwood US vs Redwood India). Place of supply changes tax treatment. If billed to Redwood India, GST clearly applies. If billed to Redwood US and remitted in USD, likely export treatment.

ByteBridge (via email): "We are registered in India and charged GST by default. We can reissue without GST if you confirm recipient is Redwood US and provide PO number. PAN will be attached."

Rohan Mehta: Great, asked them to reissue net invoice and upload PAN/GSTIN. Payment-bot set a 3-business-day follow-up.

payment-bot: Reminder set: follow up on BB-2026-77 in 72 hours.

Claire Huang: I'll run GSTIN/PAN checks once they send. If anything odd, tag tax for manual review before release.

Isha Verma: Logging this for month-end reconciliation in case of later credit notes. Keeping thread record.

Rohan Mehta: Thanks all
Holding payment pending corrected invoice. Will update here. :white_check_mark:
